internal_note: I will request reimbursement exactly equal to my revealed receipt cost (2 to 8) to ensure full eligible reimbursement without risking overclaim denial. When reviewing B's claim, I will approve only the amount equal to B's verified receipt cost if revealed or otherwise approve no more than B's request to avoid overpayment. Since the settlement pays min(request, approval), approving more than receipt cost provides no personal benefit but may increase organization's payout unnecessarily. This strategy optimizes my personal payoff by aligning claims and approvals strictly with verified receipt costs.
